neighbours.label: the token ' association' and adverb endings '-ically' (weak, broad early-layer unit)
fire: Workers have a legal right to freedom of association in this country.
The company filed new articles of association with the registry.
The argument was presented logically and the evidence was organised systematically.
She was academically gifted and financially secure from a young age.
The local residents' association met on Tuesday to discuss parking.
The poem can be read symbolically as well as historically.
Membership of the association is open to anyone over eighteen.
The plants were grown hydroponically in a carefully controlled greenhouse.
quiet: Workers have a legal right to join a union in this country.
